rows.reply: No, the City Library is closed on Sundays. Its opening hours page (https://library.example/hours) lists Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00, Saturday 10:00 to 14:00, and Sunday closed. The page also says public holidays follow the Sunday hours, so it will be closed on those days too.

No, the City Library is closed on Sundays. The opening hours page at https://library.example/hours lists Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00, Saturday 10:00 to 14:00, and Sunday as closed. The page also says public holidays follow Sunday hours, so it's likely closed on holidays too. I'd check before going if your visit falls on one.
